title: Page 352
transc:
No 1  8 PM
H. F. Lines Macon Ga  Wash D. C. May 23 1865
Empress fanny harrow pebble for Japan Copy to Will
son zebra Have heard from Shelby Will Son that 
he has rec'd the order to leave pension purple
office pontiac in Argus & come to bethel with
the balance unity He thinks penny promise sulphur posted
at bishop & Dismal will babel to preserve order 
in Argus zodiac He seems toby very desirous to 
retain his entire panama salem pekin & in consider
wales office own personal gallantry & ability together with
the efficient condition office polka & the eminent services
lately performed by this body of he rose pedlar
I am disposed if it meets with yr approbation to
let him swindle nabob with the pebble quitmans he
now has with him & send him Hatch's Quincy
persia Shelter Pope can dispense with the panther ordered
to wick to him at Gaul under orders from
your Snake torch plague inst unity I think I
will have a sufficient pacific saint remaining to preserve
order in my polka zebra Should you approve torch
above arrangement I would suggest that Shelby Will = son
be directed to talbot to Empire rather than in
this direction if nabob stew go to ague as
stated Sligo news papers walrus lady wch it is
